pr_title: Allow running commands on containers without focusing them
pr_body:
This adds a `con` argument to `execute_command` which allows you to specify the container to execute the command on. In most cases it leaves it as `NULL` which makes it use the focused node. We only set it when executing `for_window` criteria such as when a view maps. This means we don't send unnecessary IPC focus events, and fixes a crash when the criteria command is `move scratchpad` (because we can't give focus to a hidden scratchpad container).

Each of the shell map handlers now check to see if the view has a workspace. It won't have a workspace if criteria has moved it to the scratchpad.

To test:

* `for_window [class="Firefox"] move scratchpad` and then launch Firefox
* Try other criteria commands

Fixes #2656.

issue_context.title: [Alpha 1.0] Sway crash when moving to scratchpad in config
issue_context.body:
Sway crashes, if you move something directly from the config to the scratchpad. here is the command:
`for_window [instance=$scratchterm] move scratchpad`
sway version: 1.0-alpha.5-362-g5abf8322 (Sep 17 2018, branch 'master')
comments: I don't know how sway handles this internally but it sounds like the porblem is the `move` part. Might be related to #2657

Yeah, it is the move part,
[for_window [instance=$scratchterm] floating enable](url)
and
[for_window [instance=$scratchterm] resize set 1000 600](url)
work fine

I looked into this. In `view_execute_criteria`, we set focus to the view while running the criteria command, then restore focus back to whatever it was previously. When the view is mapping, prior focus is the same view. The crash occurs because we're setting the focus to the hidden scratchpad container, and `seat_set_focus_warp` rightfully assumes that the node being given focus is not a hidden scratchpad container.

A naive approach would be to make `seat_set_focus_warp` handle a hidden scratchpad container correctly, or change `view_execute_criteria` to avoid setting focus if the container has moved to the scratchpad. I think the best option is to change how commands are executed so we can run commands/criteria on a view without having to give it focus.
+1 to running commands without having to give focus, I've wanted to do that but I'm not sure how it would be done

review_comments: Maybe `seat_set_focus_container` on line 405 can be removed now?
Ah, I missed that. Removed now.
